entries.1549f721aadc9ddd: In addition to banking, the group includes companies engaged in securities, leasing, information services and research, venture capital and other businesses. As of March 31, 2026, according to the status of affiliated companies, Hamagin TT Securities Co., Ltd. conducts securities business (voting rights held: 60%), Hamagin Finance Co., Ltd. conducts leasing, Yokohama Capital Co., Ltd. conducts venture capital business, The Hamagin Research Institute, Ltd. conducts information services and research, and Yokohama Credit Guarantee Co., Ltd. conducts guarantee business. In addition, L&F Asset Finance Co., Ltd. conducts money lending business (voting rights held: 85%), and Higashi-Nippon Bank JCB Card and Bankcard Service handle card-related business. In April 2025 the company made L&F Asset Finance Co., Ltd. a consolidated subsidiary, and in January 2026 it made MILIZE Co., Ltd., which engages in AI and fintech-related business, an equity-method affiliate. Because no segment amounts are printed, no amount for this business is given here.
